purpose: Diagnostic V1 attribute-score compatibility and reviewer assessment; not search embeddings or a native-representation optimization verdict

input_recipe.scale: Eleven numeric choices map directly to integers 0 through 10; declared nonordinal choices remain null
held_equal_within_each_title: All 74 question definitions and declared order

schedule.rotation: Fixed shared-title rounds with deterministic model-order rotation; no opportunistic reordering

numerical_lanes.original: Historical raw/parser/runtime flags preserved; use per-field eligibility masks
numerical_lanes.Jev: All three whole attempts ineligible; raw observations only
numerical_lanes.Span: Original numeric cells withheld; explicitly retrospective diagnostic lane only

accounting.price_scope: Scores-only; not accepted-vector pricing or complete-pipeline savings
accounting.native_internal_work: Provider-native scoring groups, passes and actual internal fanout remain unobserved; external POST count is not internal-work count

review.assessment: Independent frontier-model review plus assisted human final selection pending
review.confidence: Moderate for prioritizing further validation; low for production suitability

reproducibility_limits: Exact request, response, synopsis and reference-source bytes and detailed custody remain private outside the public repository
Public code, schema and aggregate allow inspection of mechanics and arithmetic, not independent exact rerun or verification of every source passage
No factual gold or known original catalog producer/model/prompt/version/episode cutoff
Familiar exposed development cases, including prior exposure to unscheduled synthetic drafts; not a fresh holdout
No new configuration repeats or paired current Qwen/generative control; historical runs are not equivalent controls
No companions, search, embeddings or full-pipeline measurement
Three POST latency observations per family are not throughput or a reliability distribution
Advertised and returned model names do not prove immutable weights or independently attested serving region
